planned_argument_object.prompt:
Create ONE finished, single flat opaque public-event poster, portrait width:height 2:3, full bleed, no mockup, no border framing, no comparison sheet. Use case: ads-marketing. A friendly Korean neighborhood gathering for repairing and exchanging everyday belongings. Make a confident editorial catalog of reused objects, rather than a commercial shopping catalog.

Visual construction: a bright clean pale ivory printing surface, deep near-black Korean sans-serif type, a few quiet pale-blue printed module surfaces, and real colors of ordinary belongings. Distribute FOUR clear photographic cutouts of different sizes across an asymmetric field occupying roughly the upper 72%: a worn ochre clothbound book with slightly softened corners and no cover or spine text at left center; a recognizable pale-blue shirt at upper right with a visibly sewn small contrasting fabric patch, stitches and repaired seam; a used burgundy ceramic mug at mid-left with a complete plausible handle; and a small olive canvas shoulder bag at lower right of the image field with readable strap and naturally worn seams. Show actual material textures and ordinary use, not exaggerated grime. The repaired shirt and exchangeable belongings should make the event's purpose concrete. Objects are photographically observed, cut out with precise natural edges and internal dimensional shading; do not add uniform fake cast shadows, frames, 3D decoration or extraneous props. No single huge hero object. Some image shapes can meet the module boundary, but keep every object recognizable and all type unobscured.

Whole layout: refined asymmetry and varied module widths/heights, never equal repeated tiles or three uniform horizontal scene strips. Upper-left date/time/place group uses a clean aligned information block near the book; upper-right shirt is a taller image module. Middle mug and lower bag create offset rhythms, with the bring/activity information adjacent to the mended shirt and exchangeable objects. Keep ample but purposeful gaps, crisp alignments and varying photo/type adjacencies. Lower area is anchored by the COMPLETE title on ONE very large bold horizontal baseline spanning more than two module widths, with the event identification and prominent free-admission information directly below as a clear companion group. Final invitation is a relaxed small-but-readable line at the bottom. Do not place all practical information in a tiny footer. The title and free event identity must feel welcoming and energetic, clearly public rather than a product listing.

PRINT ONLY the following exact copy, each entry ONCE, preserving every Hangul syllable, word space, numeral and punctuation. Placement and typography:
• lower full-width title, heavy confident sans-serif, approximately 68px at a 720px-wide view: "한 번 더 쓰는 하루"
• below title, clear prominent event identification, approximately 30px at 720px width: "동네 수선·교환 모임"
• upper-left schedule block, approximately 30px at 720px width: "2026.11.14 토요일"
• immediately below date, approximately 30px at 720px width: "13:00–17:00"
• same upper schedule block, approximately 30px at 720px width: "연희 생활센터"
• middle information module adjacent to the repaired shirt and bag, approximately 25px at 720px width, can wrap at the comma into two lines while preserving word spaces: "고칠 물건 하나, 바꿀 물건 하나"
• adjoining activity line/module, approximately 24px at 720px width, wrap only at a natural word boundary if needed: "작은 옷 수선 · 생활물건 교환"
• clear bold companion to the event identity, approximately 29px at 720px width: "참가비 없음"
• final invitation, approximately 25px at 720px width: "천천히 들러요"

Every date, time, location and participation line must read easily at 720px poster width. Use well-proportioned intact Hangul with open counters, consistent stroke construction, clean baseline and normal word spacing. No extra text on objects, price tags, numbers, labels, branding, logo, watermark, invented copy, microtext or ornamental glyphs. This is one complete poster, with legitimate content-based object/information modules inside it. Preserve the 2:3 portrait ratio. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
